why: Thresholds for tools/body/check.py. Only 'hard' fails the run (exit 1): the same head and weight sanity. Everything under 'targets' is reported against, never failed, until the P1 lead tightens it after B's first run.

hard.why: NaN or negative weights, sums off 1 and more than 8 influences are broken exports (Godot 4.5 skins 8). The same head (--same-head) is the face's contract: the head the owner approved stays byte-identical.

weights.why: far_m: a vertex weighted > 0.05 to a bone more than 18 cm from its segment is a stray (her breast and glute helpers reach about 12 cm); island_weight: a bone's weight above 0.02 should be one connected patch.

targets.why: Girth and area: a joint keeps its flesh (volume loss is the candy-wrapper and the pinch; gain past 10 percent is a balloon). Penetration: skin folding through itself shows at the close-up once deeper than about 3 mm (3 px at 9.4 px/cm); the rest pose's count is the leak floor of an open mesh. Outline: 2 mm mean is 2 px at the close-up, 5 mm max a visible shape error. Silhouette: within 3 px at the close-up and the Look (PIPELINE P1). Topology (report-only): folds over 60 deg off templates and the cleft floor loop, quads over aspect 4, edges under 2 mm and non-designed poles within 40 mm of a bend zone, all 0 (topo_gates.py's limits).

silhouette.why: The Look camera's scale was not pinned in 10 minutes of godot/src reading (GameFront.PoseCreate frames the whole figure at about 6.2 m with the 34 degree lens, about 2.9 px/cm at 1080p; the face step frames closer): 30 px/cm per the P1 brief's fallback, the stricter scale.
